---
name: implement-features
description: Use this prompt when implementing a feature or features defined in the bats/tests folder.
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Implement all features which will pass all tests the bats tests found in the ``` bats/tests ``` folder.

The only file you should edit is the Dockerfile located at  ``` image/Dockerfile ```

The command to check your work is ``` bash main.bash ```

Again all tests must pass, not skip, error, or fail. 

Repeat this step as many times as necessary.
